summary: The current plan remains fit for the latest bounded research request. Both findings resolved by R3 remain resolved, and the authored report preserves the distinction between research recommendations, review-required product amendments, and actual application implementation. No plan-level blocking findings remain.

resolved_findings.resolution: Plan decisions and contract DR-1 still distinguish the explicit Electron/macOS/Windows/app-owned OpenCode v2 sidecar choice from review-required PRD/UX v0.6 amendments and prior exact-hash approvals. ADR-0002 and spec-index v0.12 support this distinction; the report Current repository coverage repeats it.

Plan AC-1/AC-3 and matching contract criteria explicitly require import, create, app-list removal/archive, and physical disk/worktree deletion as separate behaviors. The current report includes a dedicated lifecycle matrix row and four separate repository audit rows, so these distinctions survive into the output.

review_notes: Plan revision 1 covers the four requested vendor families and capability groups, first-party evidence, fact/inference/documentation-gap separation, repository file/symbol evidence, baseline recommendations and ordered follow-up slices. The current research artifact remains within that deliverable scope.

The report explicitly says the Electron application does not yet implement the workbench and labels the web workbench a synthetic read-only fixture. Existing sidecar bootstrap is described as a limited current implementation, not an implementation delivered by this research run. Its delivery sequence is explicitly a recommendation, not an approved release plan.

This is a plan verdict, not final report acceptance. The plan requires a Korean report, whereas the current report is predominantly English; report finalization/analysis review should resolve that output mismatch. Several repository-table app links use ../apps from docs/research whereas the later Sources section correctly uses ../../apps; final report review should verify and correct relative links.

The registered section/link-presence check cannot establish claim entailment or substantive source fidelity. Independent frozen-report analysis review and coordinator citation verification remain required. No vendor claims, runtime execution, packaged macOS/Windows behavior, or security enforcement were independently verified in this plan review.

Plan and canonical contract hashes were recomputed and matched the requested binding. Source hash was checked against the current run plan metadata; it was not independently regenerated from the full source snapshot.
review_boundary: Independent refresh of the focused plan against assigned latest research scope, current report, plan-r2/plan-r3 findings, PRD/UX headers and relevant lifecycle requirements, spec-index v0.12 and ADR-0002. Only this review artifact was written; no report, product document, app source or ledger edits and no runtime tests or vendor research.
